gloss: response; feedback; resistance; sense of accomplishment

definitions.gloss: response; feedback; resistance felt when doing something
definitions.explanation: The physical or metaphorical sensation of response or resistance when interacting with something.

definitions.gloss: sense of accomplishment; feeling that something was worthwhile
definitions.explanation: The satisfying feeling that one's efforts have produced a result or made an impact.

examples.japanese: ドアをノックしたが{手応|てごた}えがなかった。
examples.english: I knocked on the door but got no response.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}が{釣|つ}れた{手応|てごた}えを{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt the pull of a fish biting.

examples.japanese: バットにボールが{当|あ}たった{手応|てごた}えがあった。
examples.english: I felt the solid contact of the ball hitting the bat.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{面接|めんせつ}は{手応|てごた}えがあった。
examples.english: I felt like the interview went well this time.

examples.japanese: {手応|てごた}えのある{仕事|しごと}がしたい。
examples.english: I want to do work that feels rewarding.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{教|おし}え{方|かた}を{試|ため}したら{手応|てごた}えがあったので、これからも{続|つづ}けていこうと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: When I tried the new teaching method I got a positive response, so I plan to keep using it.

notes:
{手応|てごた}え combines {手|て} (hand) and {応|こた}え (response): the resistance or reaction you feel through your hands, and figuratively the sense that your effort registered.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手応|てごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to feel a response, to get a positive reaction)
- {手応|てごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no response, nothing came back)
- {手応|てごた}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel a response)
- {手応|てごた}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (rewarding, satisfyingly demanding)

USAGE:
After an interview, an exam, or a negotiation, {手応|てごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧ means it went well — you sensed the other side responding. The physical sense (a fish on the line, a bat meeting the ball) is still live alongside it.
